question: Does local half-product substitutability preserve downstream behavior and finite intervention responses?

candidates.spaces: native plus all16 M87 projected output spaces
candidates.selection: No space, seed, supervision arm, or random permutation selected by performance. Half retention is the prespecified balanced damage case; no smaller-subset tuning.

input_access: Executable predictor from native normalized MLP1 input z. Native products use frozen M77 L/R weights; native output W or orthonormal projected output map. Fixed affine offsets and native Down_bias handled separately. No native write consumed by predictor.
preflight_before_evaluation: Freeze manifest with candidate source/state/subset/scalar hashes.
Training doc0 only: independent float64 algebra and input-access guard for all119 candidates; relative write tolerance1e-5.

Native full control replay output KL<=1e-8 and full learned-space references compared to their existing projected-write implementations at relative write tolerance1e-5. Retain failures; do not relax tolerances or execute evaluation if unresolved.
Audit source/final/identity three-corner intervention construction on a training pair before heldout evaluation.

evaluation.natural: all32 existing natural documents32-63, downstream KL/CE/top1, local output error, save full output vectors
evaluation.whole_task: all56 fixed whole-task pairs, both endpoints; all7 families and fixed contrast-qualified5; preserve weak/ineligible cases
evaluation.interventions: native background/predicted change, predicted background/native change, both predicted; source, final, identity. Same M88 native teacher and region definitions.
evaluation.reporting: Retention, task contrasts/top1, local geometry, causal fidelity, product count separately; raw and scaled arms and full references; equal-family and pooled metrics; no discovery claim.

audit: Independent input/product predictions, frozen rankings/scalars and all saved response vectors. Hash receipts and atomic resume; no duplicate running jobs.
stop: One complete fixed comparison, then decide whether product/output dictionary separation warrants new training or whether retained common background fails task-changing directions. No new local ranking, scalar fitting, optimizer sweep, or native width minimality claim.
